requirements.verbatim_text: Responses Due: August 12, 2026, by 10:00 a.m. Central Time
The Successful Respondent must provide comprehensive CNA Services necessary for the effective management and operation of the State Use Program, which include, but are not limited to:
Maintain and dispose of records in accordance with applicable laws and TWC directives and provide any or all records requested within three (3) weeks of the request;
Demonstrate compliance with state and federal tax laws and payroll laws by submitting quarterly reports of sales and taxes paid to CPA and the Internal Revenue Service (IRS); and
responding to customer complaints within one (1) Business Day or less, and
Respond to inquiries about individual sales and/or total sales within five (5) Business Days or sooner and submit quarterly reports regarding the number of inquiries and average response time.
Financial Management: Provide sufficient financial resources and/or the ability to maintain a line of credit to pay CRPs within thirty (30) Business Days.
The Successful Respondent shall act as the primary facilitator between the applicable state agency and the CRP to define the site-specific scope of work and pricing.
The Successful Respondent must review the CRP	o to to ensure that it represents a fair market price, complies with TWC guidelines, and covers required wages and administrative fees.

The Successful Respondent is solely responsible for compiling the completed package (including statement of work, pricing schedules, and compliance certifications) and submitting it to TWC for statutory review and approval.
Upon receiving written approval from TWC, the Successful Respondent shall promptly enter into a direct contract with the applicable state agency.
The Successful Respondent must submit fully validated pricing proposals to TWC within ten (10) Business Days of reaching an agreement in principle between the applicable state agency and the CRP.
Contracts for Non-Uniformly Priced Services must include a provision permitting assignment to a successor CNA with notice to TWC.

The Successful Respondent must staff with Key Personnel identified in the Proposal which are considered by the Successful Respondent to be essential to administering the PPD State Use Program and fulfilling the requirements of the resulting Contract.

Prior to substituting any of the proposed individuals, the Successful Respondent must notify TWC and obtain written approval of the proposed substitution as soon as possible, but no less than five (5) Business Days prior to said substitution.

The Successful Respondent must provide a minimum of one (1) dedicated Account Manager who is assigned full-time to the PPD State Use Program and is primarily responsible for working with TWC on resolving day-to-day issues.

Account Manager(s) must be accessible by telephone number and email, and extremely knowledgeable of all aspects of TWC\available available Monday through Friday, between the hours of 8AM through 5PM, with the exception of the state of Texas holidays.

The minimum qualifications for Successful Respondent\\Account Manager are: i. Five (5) years\ account management experience; three (3) of the past five (5) years as the account manager for the development, implementation and/or operation of accounts of comparable size and complexity to those defined within this RFP;
The Successful Respondent must provide a minimum of three (3) dedicated staff members to act as liaisons with CPA\ Statewide Procurement Division (SPD).
The Successful Respondent SPD Liaisons must involve TWC\ administration in all substantive communications with SPD.
A minimum of three (3) SPD Liaisons must be available Monday through Friday, between the hours of 8AM through 5PM, with the exception of the State of Texas holidays.
The Successful Respondent must provide designated highly qualified and experienced Key Personnel.

The minimum qualifications for Successful Respondent\ Key Personnel are: i. Three (3) years\ experience in performing and providing the types and level of services required in this RFP, preferably as an employee or as a subcontractor or other authorized representative of the Successful Respondent;
The Successful Respondent must maintain consistent and effective communication with TWC, SPD, and the CRPs.
The Successful Respondent must maintain all necessary records for audit purposes in accordance with state and federal law and directives set forth by TWC.

In the event that a Successor Respondent is chosen at the end of the term of the resulting Contract, the Successful Respondent must extend Services to TWC for a period of one hundred and twenty (120) days or until such reasonable time that services from the new Successor Respondent are available and the CRPs and their customers have received notice of the change, as determined by TWC.
The Successful Respondent must track Texas legislation and keep abreast of changing factors that could impact the State Use Program and inform TWC of such factors.
The Successful Respondent must attend Purchasing from People with Disabilities\ Advisory Committee meetings and provide support for the Committee as requested by TWC.
The Successful Respondent must perform other duties as assigned by TWC in support of this Contract.
Quarterly Report ... Frequency / Due Date: Quarterly
Annual Report ... Frequency / Due Date: Annually / October 31
Semi-Annual Customer Satisfaction Survey Report ... Submit the results in a formal report to TWC at least semi-annually.

To be approved, the report must include each of the items detailed above, and be reviewed and approved by TWC. If TWC determines the report is incomplete, Successful Respondent will have one week to revise the report and submit to TWC for review and approval.
Deliverable #1: Quarterly Report. Successful Respondent must submit a quarterly report detailing the following items:
Deliverable #2: Annual Report. Successful Respondent must submit a report annually by October 31 detailing the following items:
Deliverable #3: Semi-Annual Customer Satisfaction Survey Report. Successful Respondent must submit a semi-annual report detailing the following items:
Pre-Solicitation Conference Attendance is optional July 07, 2026 at 2:00 P.M. central time
Deadline for Submitting Questions or Requests for Clarification July 07, 2026 at 5:00 P.M. Central Time
Deadline for Submission of Response NOTE: Responses must be RECEIVED by TWC by the deadline. August 12, 2026 at 10:00 A.M. Central Time

Respondent must submit its Response to TWC in accordance with the due date and time as indicated in this Table 3: Schedule of Events or as changed via an Addendum posted to the ESBD and the TWC Procurement Portal.

All requests, questions, or other communication about this Solicitation must be made in writing to Procurement Services, addressed to the person listed below (Sole Point of Contact) with the Solicitation number in the subject line.
A prospective Respondent should plan to attend the Pre-Solicitation Conference.
Attendees to the virtual Pre-Solicitation Conference are required to register for the conference utilizing the link provided in Section 3.6.2 Logistical Information.

People with disabilities who wish to attend the Pre-Solicitation Conference and require auxiliary aids or services should contact the Sole Point of Contact identified in Section 3.5 Sole Point of Contact at least seventy-two (72) hours before the Conference in order to have reasonable accommodations made by TWC.

Questions must be submitted through the TWC Procurement Portal to the Sole Point of Contact listed in Section 3.5 Sole Point of Contact by the deadline established in Section 3.2 Schedule of Events using Form 5 Questions and Answers. Include the Solicitation section and page number to which each question applies.

Respondents are required to acknowledge the Addenda by returning the signed Acknowledgment of Addenda with the Response. Failure to do so may disqualify the Respondent and does not absolve a Respondent from the requirements contained within any Addenda.
Respondent is not required to submit a VetHUB Subcontracting Plan with its Response.
Responses must be received by PS as prescribed no later than the date and time specified in Section 3.2 Schedule of Events.
Responses received after the deadline specified in Section 3.2 Schedule of Events will be rejected and will not be evaluated or considered for Contract award.
Respondent must fully and completely address all requirements described in this Solicitation. Incomplete or partial Responses will not be considered.

The Response to this Solicitation must: a. Be responsive to all Solicitation requirements; b. Be in the 8 1/2" by 11" paper layout; c. Be clearly legible; and d. Be presented using font type Verdana or Arial, font size 12-point, with one (1) inch margins and 1.25 line spacing; the sole 12-point font size exception is no less than size 10 point for tables, graphs, and appendices.
Respondent must upload all documentation indicated to the TWC Procurement Portal on the "Open Opportunities" tab. Submissions by any other method will not be accepted.
To respond to this Solicitation, Respondents must register through the TWC Procurement Portal website.
Respondents must contact the Sole Point of Contact prior to the deadline if there are issues with using the TWC Procurement Portal and an alternative submission method may be required.
Hard copies received will not be accepted or reviewed.

Required Forms and Submission Documents: Narrative Proposal (Section 4.7); Form 1 Execution of Response (Section 4.7.2); Form 2 Cost Response (Section 4.9); Form 3 References (Section 4.8); Financial Statements (Section 4.11); Form 5 Substitute W-9 and Direct Deposit Form; Proof of designation as a nonprofit organization by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) (Section 5.2 b.)

Respondent must provide an Executive Summary of their Response (excluding cost information) that asserts the Respondent is providing, in its Response, all the requirements of this Solicitation, including Article II Scope of Work.
The Executive Summary must not exceed five (5) pages and should represent a full and concise summary of the contents of the Response.
Respondent must complete, sign, and return Form 1 Execution of Response.
A Response without the required signatures is not responsive to the Solicitation and will be disqualified.

Respondent must provide the name, address, and telephone number of Respondent\ point of contact for any questions regarding the Response and, if different than the point of contact for questions about the Response, the name, address, and telephone number of Respondent\ point of contact for any resulting Contract.
Respondent must provide a detailed narrative explaining why it is qualified to provide the services enumerated in Article II Scope of Work, focusing on key strengths and competitive advantages.

Respondent must describe its knowledge and experience in providing Program Management Services to comparable clients of similar size and complexity to TWC, including how many years Respondent has been managing the program. The Organization Narrative must not exceed two (2) pages.

Respondent must provide an organizational profile, including: a. Ownership structure ...; b. The year the company was founded and/or incorporated ...; c. The location of company headquarters and any field office(s) ...; d. The number of employees ...; and e. An indication of whether the company has ever been in contract with any Texas state agency.

Description of Services. Respondent must affirm its intent to comply with the requirements as stated in Section 2.2 Description of Services, and affirm that it will continue to comply with these requirements during the term of the Contract issued as a result of this Solicitation, if any.

Comprehensive CNA Services. Respondent must affirm and document how its Proposal meets the requirements as stated in Section 2.2.1 Comprehensive CNA Services, and affirm that it will continue to comply with these requirements during the term of the Contract issued as a result of this Solicitation, if any.
Respondent must provide staffing profiles and resumes for all dedicated key personnel who will be assigned to the Contract that demonstrates their ability to meet the requirements of their roles.

Respondent must also provide staffing profiles and resumes for all other key personnel assigned to career counseling and staff development training for disabled employees. Include the amount of time each of these positions will have committed to the execution of the contract.
Respondent must provide a minimum of three (3) references in the format set forth in Form 3 References and should also provide any canceled contract reference as applicable.

One (1) reference must relate to similar contracts or projects performed as described in Section 2.2 Description of Services within the last five (5) years, and must be from state, federal, and/or local governmental entities. Do not include TWC as a reference.
One (1) reference must verify your organization\ financial capacity to operate a project in the total dollar amount requested in this solicitation.

Each Respondent shall provide descriptions for a minimum of one (1) engagement of comparable complexity and sensitivity to the requirements of this Solicitation that have been conducted within the past five (5) years.
The Respondent shall state whether or not any of the following have occurred during the last five (5) years:
In accordance with Section 4.9 Cost Response, the Respondent shall include one file named "Cost Response" that contains the Respondent\ Cost Response in the format included in Form 2 Cost Response.
Cost information must be included as a separate document and presented only in the format set forth in Form 2 Cost Response.
Respondent must propose their fee to manage and coordinate the State Use Program under the oversight and direction of TWC.
Respondents are encouraged to describe any Offered Options. Offered Options are not required and are not considered during evaluation of Responses.

The Respondent must include the following items in its Response unless it is a governmental entity. Failure to include any of the items listed for the appropriate company type may result in disqualification of the Respondent\ Response.

In addition to the Financial Statements provided under Section 4.11.2, the Respondent must provide proof of sufficient financial resources to pay or maintain a line of credit to pay CRPs within thirty (30) Business Days as required by Section 2.2.1(f).
The Respondent must provide the following information in an electronic file/document that is named in this format: "[Organization Name] _TWC_RFP_No. #3202600177 Financial_Information.docx".
For the last three (3) fiscal years most recently ended, audited financial statements prepared in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Practices (GAAP);
The Successful Respondent must provide the financial statements in Section 4.11.1 Financial Statements annually throughout the term of the Contract.
The Response must include a certification that the Respondent will notify TWC of a change in financial condition during the Contract term and any renewal thereof.

If the Respondent is substantially owned or controlled, in whole or in part, by one or more other legal entities, the Respondent must submit the information required under Section 4.11 Financial Soundness above for each such entity, including the most recent financial statement for each such entity.
If a Respondent includes exceptions in its Response, Respondent is required to use Form 1 Execution of Response and provide all information requested on the form.
Respondent must clearly identify the specific section and language to which it takes exception, propose specific alternative language, and describe its reasoning for requesting the exception.
Respondent must be set up in the Texas franchise tax system prior to Contract award if applicable.

A Respondent subject to this requirement must: a. complete TEC Form 1295, Certificate of Interested Parties ...; b. submit the form online to TEC, c. print the completed form that includes the Certificate Number automatically assigned by TEC, and d. submit the form, signed by its authorized agency, by email to TWC.

Respondent must notify the Sole Point of Contact identified in Section 3.5 Sole Point of Contact of any ambiguity, conflict, discrepancy, exclusionary specification, omission, or error in the Solicitation in the manner and by the deadline described in Section 3.7 Questions/Requests for Clarification.
Responses submitted to the Solicitation are irrevocable for one hundred eighty (180) calendar days following the solicitation closing date.
A Respondent must meet the minimum qualifications listed below. Failure to meet any one of the minimum qualifications listed below may result in a disqualification of that Response.

Respondent must have recently been in business for a minimum of five (5) years, or the principals/owners must have had ownership/executive management experience within the last five (5) in a previous company that provided program management services;

Respondent must submit proof that they are designated as a nonprofit organization by the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) such as: IRS Determination Letter, State Registration Certificate or Form 990 Filings;
Respondent must submit a complete and signed Form 1 Execution of Response, in accordance with Section 4.7.2 Execution of Response;
Respondent must be financially solvent and adequately capitalized, as determined based on a review of documentation required by Section 4.11 Financial Soundness;
Respondent has submitted the Response in accordance with Article IV Response Submission Instructions; see also Section 4.6 Required Forms and Submission Documents;
Respondent who receives an overall score on the VPTS of "D" or below shall be disqualified from consideration for award.

TWC shall consistently evaluate and score Responses in accordance with the following criteria. a. Ability to Perform Services (50%) ... b. Past Performance, Experience, Qualifications, and References (40%) ... c. Price or Reasonableness of Price Proposal (10%)

If Respondent asserts that information provided in its Response is exempt from disclosure under the Texas Public Information Act, Respondent must mark and submit two separate, searchable Portable Document Format (PDF) copies (Original Response and "Public Information Act Copy," including attachments, of the Original Response) as identified below.

Within five (5) days from Contract execution, the Successful Respondent must submit a "Public Information Act Copy" of the Original Executed Contract (in addition to the original executed contract) to the TWC contract manager by email.

For the duration of any Contract resulting from this Solicitation, the Successful Respondent shall acquire insurance, bonds, or both, with financially sound and reputable independent insurers, in the type and amount listed in Attachment 1 ",
The Response must include a certification that the entity is not for sale or to become acquired by another business entity during the twelve (12) months following the Response Deadline.

During the term of the Contract or any extension or renewal thereof, the Successful Respondent shall notify TWC in writing of any substantial change in the ownership or control of the Successful Respondent as soon as possible, but no later than thirty (30) days prior to its occurrence.
The Successful Respondent shall meet or exceed the service criteria and timelines below.
